items.title: [Bug]: Search fails with Code 0 immediately after Collection.load() returns success
items.setup: No REST v2 for this (v2.3 gRPC-era issue); use pymilvus. Create collection test_47635: id VARCHAR(64) pk, vector FLOAT_VECTOR dim=4. Insert 1 row, flush, create_index FLAT/L2, collection.load(), then immediately collection.search with no sleep. Repeat a few times to hit the race (standalone has low success rate).

probe_cases.desc: search immediately after load returns code=0 with 'collection not loaded'
probe_cases.observe: Capture MilvusException code+message right after load() returns. Defect if code==0 while message indicates a failure (collection not loaded).

items.expectation: Code 0 == Success per Milvus R.Status; a failing search must return a proper error code (e.g. 101), or load() must not return success before the collection is ready.
items.contract_hint: Code 0 is defined as Success in the Milvus API specification; search failing with code=0 violates the contract.
items.manual_reason: v2.3 gRPC-era (pre REST-v2): needs a live v2.3/v2.6 gRPC server and a timing race (low standalone success rate). Requires manual/CI concurrency orchestration.

items.title: [Bug]: Expr parser returns code=0 (Success) and leaks internal lexer errors
items.setup: No REST v2 priority for this (v2.3 gRPC-era). Create pymilvus collection test_47636: id VARCHAR(64) pk, vector FLOAT_VECTOR dim=4, tag VARCHAR(64). Insert 1 row, flush, create_index FLAT/L2, load. Search with invalid expr 'tag === {q}x{q}'.

probe_cases.desc: invalid boolean expr returns code=0 and leaks ANTLR lexer error
probe_cases.observe: Capture MilvusException code+message. Defect if code==0 and message contains lexer/parser internals ('token recognition error'); expected code!=0 (IllegalArgument) with clean message.

items.expectation: Code 0 == Success; an unparsable expression must return a proper error code (IllegalArgument) with a sanitized message, not expose parser internals.
items.contract_hint: Code 0 defined as Success; invalid expressions should trigger IllegalArgument per HighlevelAPI search() spec.
items.manual_reason: v2.3 gRPC-era issue, STALE_NO_FIX: behavior may differ on the harness image; probe is informational and gRPC-only.

items.title: [Bug]: Index parameter nprobe validation missing - accepts nprobe=0
items.setup: Create pymilvus Collection test_47729: id INT64 pk auto_id=False, vector FLOAT_VECTOR dim=128. Insert 10 rows, flush, create_index IVF_FLAT/L2 nlist=100, load.

probe_cases.desc: IVF_FLAT search with nprobe=0 accepted (should fail)
probe_cases.observe: Whether search returns results/code 0 (defect) or a clear validation error (nprobe>0 required).

items.expectation: IVF-family nprobe must be a positive integer; nprobe=0 should be rejected with a clear error.
items.contract_hint: Index doc: 'nprobe: Number of cluster units to search ... Must be a positive integer.'

items.title: [Bug]: Index parameter ef validation missing - accepts ef=0
items.setup: Use MilvusClient uri=http://localhost:19530. create_collection('test_47752', dimension=128, metric_type='L2'). Insert 1 row. create_index HNSW {M:16, efConstruction:100}. Search with search_params={'ef':0}.

probe_cases.desc: HNSW search with ef=0 accepted (should fail)
probe_cases.observe: Whether search succeeds (defect) or returns a clear validation error.

items.expectation: HNSW ef must be a positive integer; ef<=0 should be rejected.
items.contract_hint: HNSW doc: 'ef must be a positive integer'; symmetric to nprobe validation expectation.

items.title: [Bug]: Filter expression validation too lenient
items.setup: Create pymilvus Collection test_47755: id INT64 pk, vector FLOAT_VECTOR dim=128, age INT64. Insert 10 rows (age 0,10,...,90), flush, create_index IVF_FLAT/L2 nlist=100, load.

probe_cases.desc: descending IN range 'age in [10,5]' accepted instead of rejected/normalized
probe_cases.observe: Whether search succeeds (defect) or rejects with a range-order error.

probe_cases.desc: empty IN range 'age in []' accepted instead of rejected
probe_cases.observe: Whether search succeeds (defect) or rejects empty range.

items.expectation: Semantically invalid filter expressions (descending / empty IN range) should be rejected or normalized, not silently accepted.
items.contract_hint: Boolean Expression doc: filter expressions should be validated for semantic correctness (ascending, non-empty ranges).

items.title: [Bug]:  Field name validation missing - accepts invalid field names causing data inaccessibility
items.setup: Create REST collection test_47763 with schema id Int64 pk + vector FloatVector dim=4, enableDynamicField=True. Insert rows with dynamic keys '123field','@field','my-field','valid_field'.

probe_cases.desc: insert invalid dynamic field names accepted, then query/read-back fails
probe_cases.observe: insert code (defect if 0/200). Then entities/query with outputFields ['123field'] and ['@field']; expect 'parse output field name failed' confirming data written but unreadable.

probe_cases.desc: valid field name control
probe_cases.observe: insert and query should both work for the valid field.

items.expectation: Resource (field) names must start with letter/underscore and contain [A-Za-z0-9_]; writing a field that can't be read back breaks data accessibility.
items.contract_hint: Milvus Limitations doc: 'A resource name must start with a letter or an underscore'.

items.title: [Bug]: Data type validation missing - accepts integer into string field
items.setup: Create REST collection test_47766 dimension=4 (dynamic field enabled by default). Insert row1 with text_field='hello' (establishes VARCHAR), then row2 with text_field=12345.

probe_cases.desc: second insert of int into established VARCHAR dynamic field accepted (type mismatch)
probe_cases.observe: insert code (defect if 0/200). Then query id in [1,2] output text_field and check str-vs-int type inconsistency in same field.

items.expectation: Entities in one collection must share per-field data types; inserting INT64 into a VARCHAR-established dynamic field should be rejected.
items.contract_hint: Insert Entities doc: 'entities within the same Collection have the same attributes (field names, data types...)'.

items.title: [Bug]: Empty query vector accepted in search - no validation error
items.setup: Create pymilvus Collection test_47767: id VARCHAR(64) pk, vector FLOAT_VECTOR dim=2. Insert 2 rows, flush, create_index FLAT/L2, load. Search with data=[[]] (empty query vector).

probe_cases.desc: empty query vector [] accepted in search
probe_cases.observe: Whether search returns results (claimed defect) or a dimension/empty-vector error. GT=BY_DESIGN; report observed behavior for GLM.

items.expectation: Query vector dimension must be >0 and match the collection dim; an empty [] query vector violates this.
items.contract_hint: Java SDK withDimension: 'dimension must be greater than zero'; dense vectors are fixed-length arrays.

items.title: fix: add nprobe parameter validation for IVF index search
items.setup: Self-authored PR; payload is fully covered by parent issue #47729 (nprobe=0 validation). No standalone probe.

probe_cases.desc: PR content traces to #47729; no separate probe
probe_cases.observe: Skip probe; treat as duplicate/dependency of #47729.

items.expectation: PR adds nprobe>0 validation for IVF-family indexes; the asserted behavior is exercised by the #47729 probe.
items.contract_hint: PR description: 'adds validation for the nprobe search parameter to ensure it must be greater than 0' (Fixes #47729).
items.manual_reason: This is a fix PR (SELF_PR_CLOSED), not a default-state defect to replay; it changes server code. The #47729 probe covers the behavioral claim. Not executed as a standalone probe.

items.title: [Bug]: COSINE Metric Returns Distance > 1.0 for Identical Vectors (Precision Overflow)
items.setup: Create pymilvus Collection test_49059: pk INT64 auto_id=True, embeddings FLOAT_VECTOR dim=128. Insert 10000 normalized unit vectors (numpy), flush. create_index IVF_FLAT/COSINE nlist=128, load. Search with data set to normalized vectors, limit=1.

probe_cases.desc: COSINE distance for identical normalized vectors exceeds 1.0 (float precision)
probe_cases.observe: Check hits[0].distance for the self-match; defect if >1.0. 10k-row insert is heavy; may reduce row count to speed up.

items.expectation: COSINE similarity of identical normalized vectors is mathematically <= 1.0; returning >1.0 violates the metric bound (needs clamp).
items.contract_hint: Milvus metric doc: cosine similarity bounded in [-1,1]; >1.0 indicates unclamped precision error.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 accepts nprobe=0 in search requests without validation
items.setup: Create REST collection test_nprobe dimension=4 metricType=L2 (AUTOINDEX/IVF family). Insert 3 rows. Load.

probe_cases.desc: search with nprobe=0 returns success instead of validation error
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status + JSON code/message. Defect if code==0 with results; expected nprobe range error.

probe_cases.desc: control: limit=0 correctly rejected
probe_cases.observe: Expect code=65535 'topk [0] is invalid' confirming topk validated but nprobe is not.

items.expectation: IVF-family nprobe must be >=1 to probe buckets; nprobe=0 should be rejected like limit=0.
items.contract_hint: Milvus validates topk/limit range but not nprobe; nprobe semantic contract requires probing at least one bucket.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 returns success when creating a collection with a duplicate name
items.setup: Create REST collection test_dup dimension=4 metricType=L2 twice; verify collections/list shows one.

probe_cases.desc: re-creating an existing collection returns code=0 instead of error
probe_cases.observe: First create code 0; second identical create also code 0 (defect: duplicate create should error). Then list to confirm only one collection exists.

items.expectation: Duplicate object creation should error ('collection already exists'); code=0 for a no-op create masks the condition.
items.contract_hint: Consistent with other DBs: re-creating an existing collection should fail with an error.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 silently drops negative collection.ttl.seconds on collection create
items.setup: Create REST collection test_ttl_neg dimension=4 metricType=L2 properties collection.ttl.seconds=-100. Compare describe vs alter_properties.

probe_cases.desc: create with negative TTL returns success but property silently dropped
probe_cases.observe: create code (defect if 0/200). describe -> if collection.ttl.seconds absent while create returned success => property silently dropped.

probe_cases.desc: control: alter_properties rejects negative TTL
probe_cases.observe: Expect code=1100 'collection TTL is out of range, expect [-1, 3155760000], got -100'.

items.expectation: create must validate collection.ttl.seconds the same as alter_properties (range [-1,3155760000]); silently dropping a negative TTL violates this.
items.contract_hint: alter_properties error message; PR #46717 added TTL validation to createCollectionTask.PreExecute but REST create bypasses it.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 query accepts null/missing filter and silently returns all entities
items.setup: Create REST collection test_coll dimension=4, insert 2 rows. Query with filter null / omitted / ''.

probe_cases.desc: query with filter:null returns all entities instead of rejecting
probe_cases.observe: JSON code and data. Claim: filter required; null/missing should error but returns all rows (code 0).

probe_cases.desc: query with filter omitted returns all entities
probe_cases.observe: Whether all rows returned code 0 (defect) vs error.

probe_cases.desc: control: filter='' documented path to query all
probe_cases.observe: Expect success (all rows) as the documented way; distinguishes from null/missing.

items.expectation: REST filter is documented required; null/missing should error (use '' to skip filtering). Returning all rows on null leaks data silently.
items.contract_hint: REST v2 Query: 'filter (string, required)'; PyMilvus: use '' to skip scalar filtering.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 insert returns insertCount=1 for duplicate primary key (upsert semantics)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_coll_sem dimension=4 metricType=L2. Insert one row id=1, then insert same id=1 with a different vector; query to verify overwrite.

probe_cases.desc: duplicate-PK insert reports insertCount=1 although it is an overwrite
probe_cases.observe: Second insert response insertCount. Claim: returns insertCount=1 (misleading) though it overwrote; verify by querying id==1 vector is the second value. Report insertCount and stored value.

items.expectation: A 200/0-for-duplicate insert is an upsert-overwrite; insertCount=1 misreports a new insert. At minimum should document or distinguish overwrite count.
items.contract_hint: Issue: 'The endpoint is called insert, not upsert. When insert reports success with insertCount=1, expectation is a new row was added.'

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 describe indexes requires indexName, cannot list all indexes
items.setup: Create REST collection test_idx with an index (AUTOINDEX on vector). Call indexes/describe without indexName and with indexName='vector'.

probe_cases.desc: describe indexes without indexName returns 'missing required parameters: IndexName'
probe_cases.observe: JSON code/message. Claim: describe without indexName cannot list all indexes (error), unlike SDK list_indexes.

probe_cases.desc: control: describe with indexName succeeds
probe_cases.observe: Expect code 0 with index details.

items.expectation: Collection-level describe should list all indexes when indexName omitted, consistent with SDK list_indexes.
items.contract_hint: Issue: SDK client.list_indexes returns all names without indexName; describe collection works with only collectionName.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 accepts empty string for `dbName` parameter
items.setup: No explicit collection needed for list. Send collections/list with dbName=''. Compare to filter='' on query which is rejected.

probe_cases.desc: collections/list with dbName='' returns success instead of validation error
probe_cases.observe: JSON code/data. Claim: code 0 with data [] (silently defaults to default db) instead of rejecting empty dbName.

probe_cases.desc: control: filter='' on query rejected (shows pattern)
probe_cases.observe: Expect code !=0 'filter cannot be empty' illustrating empty-string validation exists elsewhere.

items.expectation: dbName is documented 'name of an existing database'; empty string is invalid and should be rejected, like filter=''.
items.contract_hint: REST v2 List: 'dbName: The name of an existing database.'

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 accepts non-integer `Request-Timeout` header values
items.setup: Send collections/list {} with Request-Timeout headers 3.5 and 'abc'; compare with valid integer 10.

probe_cases.desc: float Request-Timeout header accepted (fraction silently discarded)
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status + JSON code. Defect if code 0 (success) — float should be rejected as non-integer.

probe_cases.desc: string Request-Timeout header accepted (ignored)
probe_cases.observe: Whether code 0 (defect) or a type error.

items.expectation: Request-Timeout documented as integer; float/string values should be rejected, not truncated/ignored.
items.contract_hint: v2.3.x API reference lists Request-Timeout as `integer` header.

items.title: [Bug]: Default proxy.maxDimension=32768 is too permissive, potential DoS risk via high-dimensional collection creation
items.setup: Using REST collections/create with explicit schema: try dim=32768 (accepted), dim=32769 (rejected), dim=-1 (rejected).

probe_cases.desc: collection with dim=32768 created successfully (default max too high)
probe_cases.observe: JSON code. Claim: dim=32768 accepted (code 0/200) though it risks OOM; expected default max lower (e.g. 4096/8192). Report code.

probe_cases.desc: control: dim=32769 correctly rejected
probe_cases.observe: Expect code=65535 'invalid dimension ... should be in range 2 ~ 32768'.

items.expectation: DoS-hardening suggestion: default proxy.maxDimension 32768 too permissive for real embeddings; high dims should be capped lower.
items.contract_hint: Issue: common embeddings <=3072 dims; 32768-dim vectors consume ~128KB each.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API and PyMilvus SDK have inconsistent default index creation behavior
items.setup: REST path: create collection without indexParams, then create_index (expect success). SDK path: client.create_collection(dimension=4) auto-creates AUTOINDEX, then client.create_index fails.

probe_cases.desc: REST create_index succeeds when collection created without indexParams
probe_cases.observe: JSON code. REST-created bare collection allows create_index (code 0).

probe_cases.desc: SDK create_collection(dimension=4) auto-index then create_index fails (cross-API divergence)
probe_cases.observe: client.create_collection('test_sdk_idx', dimension=4); then client.create_index -> AUTOINDEX already exists exception. Report divergence vs REST.

items.expectation: REST create without indexParams leaves no index so later create_index succeeds; SDK quick-create auto-makes AUTOINDEX so create_index fails — should be consistent.
items.contract_hint: Issue: same logical operation (create -> create_index) yields different outcomes across REST and SDK.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 accepts invalid searchParams (ef=0/-1 for HNSW, nprobe=0/-1 for IVF_FLAT) without validation
items.setup: Create HNSW collection (dim=4 indexParams HNSW efConstruction=128 M=16) + insert 1 row; create IVF_FLAT collection (nlist=128) + insert 2 rows.

probe_cases.desc: HNSW search with ef=-1 accepted
probe_cases.observe: HTTP + code. Defect if code 0 with results; expected ef range rejection.

probe_cases.desc: HNSW search with ef=0 accepted
probe_cases.observe: Defect if code 0 with results.

probe_cases.desc: IVF_FLAT search with nprobe=0 accepted
probe_cases.observe: Defect if code 0 with results; expected nprobe range [1,nlist].

items.expectation: searchParams (index-specific ef/nprobe) must be range-validated like limit/offset; ef<=0 and nprobe<1 are semantically invalid.
items.contract_hint: Issue: limit/offset validated, searchParams not; ef should be >=1, nprobe in [1,nlist].

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 aliases/list accepts empty collectionName while other endpoints properly reject it
items.setup: Create REST collection test_aliases with an alias. Call aliases/list with collectionName=''. Compare to collections/describe with collectionName='' which returns code=1802.

probe_cases.desc: aliases/list with collectionName='' returns code=0 instead of error
probe_cases.observe: JSON code/data. Claim defect if code 0 (empty list) instead of code=1802 missing-required error.

probe_cases.desc: control: collections/describe with collectionName='' correctly rejected
probe_cases.observe: Expect code=1802 'Field validation for CollectionName failed' confirming other endpoints validate.

items.expectation: collectionName is required for aliases/list; an empty string should be rejected like other endpoints (code=1802).
items.contract_hint: Issue: most endpoints return code=1802 for empty collectionName; aliases/list misses this validation.

items.title: [Bug] Concurrent rename and create with same target name both succeed, causing state violation
items.setup: Create source collection test_rename_src with data. Concurrently run rename(source->new_name) and create(new_name). Both target the same new name.

probe_cases.desc: concurrent rename-to-N and create-N both return code 0 (state violation)
probe_cases.observe: Run rename thread and create-conflict thread concurrently; capture both response codes. Defect claim if BOTH code 0, i.e. two collections with same name reconcile into an ambiguous state.

items.expectation: Two collections must not share the same name; rename and create targeting the same name must mutually exclude so only one succeeds.
items.contract_hint: Issue: rename/create lack a lock, so both succeed concurrently leaving ambiguous state.

items.title: [Bug] get_stats returns rowCount=0 after successful insert and load (v2.6.16, regression from #30663)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_rowcount (id Int64 pk, vector FloatVector dim=4, value Int64). Insert 5 rows, load, then get_stats.

probe_cases.desc: get_stats returns rowCount=0 after insert+load
probe_cases.observe: JSON rowCount. Claim defect if rowCount=0 while entities/query with filter returns 5 rows. Report both.

items.expectation: get_stats rowCount must reflect the number of entities after insert+load, matching query results.
items.contract_hint: Issue: get_stats returns 0 while query returns 5 (regression of #30663).

items.title: [Bug] Concurrent delete and search returns stale/deleted data
items.setup: Create REST collection test_stale_data (id/pk, vector dim=4, value). Insert 10 rows, create HNSW index, load. Concurrently delete ids [1..5] and search; then search again.

probe_cases.desc: search concurrent with delete returns deleted ids (stale data)
probe_cases.observe: Run delete(filter id in [1..5]) thread and search thread concurrently; collect search result ids. Defect if any deleted id (1-5) appears after delete.

items.expectation: After deletion, searches must not return deleted entities (read-after-delete visibility).
items.contract_hint: Issue: delete and search are not synchronized; search reads a segment not reflecting the delete.

items.title: [Bug] Search on unloaded collection returns valid results (code=0)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_unloaded (dimension=4 metricType=COSINE idType=Int64 autoID=False), insert 1 row, DO NOT load. Then search.

probe_cases.desc: search on never-loaded collection returns code=0 with data instead of 'not loaded' error
probe_cases.observe: JSON code + data. Claim defect if code 0 with results without a load call; expected code!=0 'collection not loaded'.

items.expectation: Contract requires load() before search/query; searching an unloaded collection should return 'collection not loaded'.
items.contract_hint: Issue: REST contract requires load before search; returns code 0 + results, bypassing collection lifecycle.

items.title: [Bug] Duplicate collection creation returns code=0 instead of error
items.setup: Create REST collection test_dup (dimension=4 metricType=COSINE) once, then create same name again.

probe_cases.desc: second create with existing name returns code=0 instead of 'already exists'
probe_cases.observe: First create code 0; second identical create also code 0 (defect: duplicate create should error).

items.expectation: Re-creating an existing collection should return 'collection already exists'; two identical successes hide the condition.
items.contract_hint: Issue: Type-1 Illegal Success — duplicate create returns identical code 0.

items.title: [Bug] Drop non-existent collection returns code=0 instead of code=4
items.setup: Call REST collections/drop on a name that does not exist (e.g. nonexistent_xyz).

probe_cases.desc: drop non-existent collection returns code=0 instead of code=4
probe_cases.observe: JSON code. Claim defect if code 0; expected code=4 (CollectionNotExists).

items.expectation: Dropping a non-existent collection should return CollectionNotExists (code=4), not an unqualified success.
items.contract_hint: Issue: REST error-code doc defines code=4 for CollectionNotExists; drop returns 0, indistinguishable from a success.

items.title: [Bug] Delete accepts both filter and ids (mutually exclusive) silently
items.setup: Create REST collection test_del (dimension=4), insert 1 row id=1. Delete with BOTH filter and ids.

probe_cases.desc: delete with both filter and ids accepted (should be rejected as mutually exclusive)
probe_cases.observe: JSON code + deleteCount. Claim defect if code 0 (no validation error) and deleteCount 0 or 1; expected mutual-exclusivity error.

items.expectation: filter and ids are mutually exclusive; supplying both must be rejected, not silently resolved.
items.contract_hint: Issue: delete documents filter OR ids as mutually exclusive; both silently accepted.

items.title: [Bug] Consistency level silently accepts invalid values and defaults to Bounded
items.setup: Create REST collection test_cl (dimension=4) with consistencyLevel='InvalidLevel'. Then describe to read back the consistencyLevel.

probe_cases.desc: invalid consistencyLevel accepted and silently defaulted to Bounded
probe_cases.observe: create code (defect if 0/200). Then collections/describe -> expect data.consistencyLevel 'Bounded' (silent substitution) instead of rejection.

items.expectation: Valid consistencyLevel values are Strong/Bounded/Session/Eventually; an invalid string should be rejected, not defaulted to Bounded.
items.contract_hint: Issue: valid values Strong, Bounded, Session, Eventually; invalid silently defaults to Bounded.

items.title: [Bug] REST API: Insert accepts 101 entities (exceeding documented 100 limit)
items.setup: Create REST collection t (dimension=4). Insert 101 entities in one call.

probe_cases.desc: insert 101 entities accepted (documented limit 100)
probe_cases.observe: JSON code + insertCount. Claim defect if code 0 with insertCount=101 (no server-side enforcement of the 100 limit).

items.expectation: REST insert documents a 100-entity-per-call limit; exceeding it should be rejected or at least enforced.
items.contract_hint: Issue: REST docs state 100 entities per call; insertCount=101 confirms no enforcement.

items.title: [Bug] REST API: Unicode-only collection names silently accepted
items.setup: Create REST collection with a Chinese-only name such as '测试集合' (dimension=128).

probe_cases.desc: Unicode-only collection name accepted despite [a-zA-Z0-9_] rule
probe_cases.observe: JSON code. Claim defect if code 0 (created); expected naming-rule rejection.

items.expectation: Collection names should match [a-zA-Z0-9_]; Unicode-only names must be rejected.
items.contract_hint: Issue: relies on #19273 confirming names restricted to [a-zA-Z0-9_].

items.title: [Bug] Rename collection to its own name returns code=0
items.setup: Create REST collection test_rename (dimension=4). Rename it to its own name.

probe_cases.desc: rename collection to its own current name returns code=0 (no-op not rejected)
probe_cases.observe: JSON code. Claim defect if code 0 (silent no-op) instead of rejecting an invalid rename.

items.expectation: Renaming to the same name is a no-op and should be rejected as an invalid operation.
items.contract_hint: Issue: Type-1 Illegal Success — no-op rename indistinguishable from a successful rename.

items.title: [Bug] Search on unloaded collection returns valid results (code=0)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_unloaded (dimension=4 metricType=COSINE idType=Int64 autoID=False), insert 1 row, DO NOT load. Search and query.

probe_cases.desc: search AND query on never-loaded collection return code=0 with data
probe_cases.observe: JSON code+data for search; then same for entities/query. Defect if code 0 with results on an unloaded collection (expected 'collection not loaded').

items.expectation: load() must precede search/query; operating on an unloaded collection should return 'collection not loaded'.
items.contract_hint: Duplicate of #50305; REST contract requires load before search/query.

items.title: [Bug] Duplicate collection creation returns code=0 instead of error
items.setup: Create REST collection test_dup (dimension=4) twice with identical payload.

probe_cases.desc: second create with existing name returns code=0 (illegal success)
probe_cases.observe: First and second create both code 0 -> defect; duplicate create indistinguishable.

items.expectation: Duplicate create must return a non-zero 'already exists' error.
items.contract_hint: Duplicate of #50306/#49824.

items.title: [Bug] Drop non-existent collection returns code=0 instead of code=4
items.setup: Drop a non-existent collection (e.g. nonexistent_collection_xyz).

probe_cases.desc: drop non-existent collection returns code=0 instead of code=4
probe_cases.observe: JSON code. Defect if 0; expected code=4 CollectionNotExists.

items.expectation: Drop of a non-existent collection should return code=4, not success.
items.contract_hint: Duplicate of #50307.

items.title: [Bug] Delete endpoint accepts both filter and ids (mutually exclusive) silently
items.setup: Create REST collection test_del (dimension=4), insert 1 row id=1. Delete with both filter and ids.

probe_cases.desc: delete with both filter and ids (mutually exclusive) silently accepted
probe_cases.observe: JSON code+deleteCount. Defect if code 0 (no validation error), filter takes precedence; expected mutual-exclusion error.

items.expectation: filter and ids are mutually exclusive; both supplied must be rejected.
items.contract_hint: Duplicate of #50308.

items.title: [Bug] REST API: Insert accepts 101 entities (exceeding documented 100 limit)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_limit (dimension=4). Insert 101 entities.

probe_cases.desc: insert 101 entities accepted (documented limit 100)
probe_cases.observe: JSON code+insertCount. Defect if code 0 with insertCount=101 (100-limit not enforced).

items.expectation: Insert has a documented 100-entity limit; exceeding it should be rejected.
items.contract_hint: Duplicate of #50310.

items.title: [Bug] Collection names with leading underscore accepted despite naming rules
items.setup: Create REST collection with name '_test_collection' (dimension=128).

probe_cases.desc: collection name starting with underscore accepted though rule requires letter start
probe_cases.observe: JSON code. Defect if code 0 (created); expected naming-rule rejection for leading underscore.

items.expectation: Collection names should start with a letter per [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*; a leading underscore should be rejected.
items.contract_hint: Issue: relies on #19273 naming convention [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*.

items.title: [Bug]: Search on unloaded collection returns valid results (code=0)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_unloaded (dimension=4), insert 1 row, DO NOT load. Search.

probe_cases.desc: search on unloaded collection returns code=0 with data
probe_cases.observe: JSON code+data. GT=BY_DESIGN; report observed behavior for GLM. Claim: expected 'collection not loaded' error.

items.expectation: load() must precede search; search on unloaded collection should error.
items.contract_hint: Duplicate of #50305; marked BY_DESIGN.

items.title: [Bug]: Duplicate collection creation returns code=0 instead of error
items.setup: Create REST collection test_dup twice with identical payload.

probe_cases.desc: second duplicate create returns code=0 (illegal success)
probe_cases.observe: Both creates return code 0 -> defect per issue; GT=BY_DESIGN so report observed.

items.title: [Bug]: Collection names with leading underscore accepted despite naming rules
items.setup: Create REST collection with name '_test_collection' (dimension=128).

probe_cases.observe: JSON code. Report observed; GT=BY_DESIGN.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2: shardsNum=0/-1/65535 accepted with HTTP 200 + code=200
items.setup: Create REST collections with shardsNum in {0,-1,65535} (dimension=4).

probe_cases.desc: shardsNum=0 accepted with HTTP 200 + code=200

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2: metricType="" and consistencyLevel="None" silently accepted on collections/create
items.setup: Create REST collections with dimension=0/-1/32769, metricType=''/'INVALID'/'l2'/'123', consistencyLevel=''/'STRONG'/'strong'/'None'/'ReadCommitted'.

probe_cases.desc: metricType='' accepted (code=200 success)
probe_cases.observe: HTTP + JSON code. Defect if code==200 success (empty metricType undefined similarity behavior).

probe_cases.desc: consistencyLevel='None' accepted (non-existent level)
probe_cases.observe: HTTP + JSON code. Defect if code==200 success; 'None' is not a valid consistency level.

probe_cases.desc: dimension=32769 returns error but via HTTP 200 (should be 400)
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status vs JSON code; defect if body has error code but HTTP 200.

items.expectation: metricType must be one of L2/IP/COSINE and consistencyLevel one of Strong/Bounded/Session/Eventually; empty or non-existent enum values should be rejected (HTTP 4xx).
items.contract_hint: Milvus metric/consistency docs list valid enums; empty strings and 'None'/'ReadCommitted' are invalid but accepted.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2: search returns HTTP 200 for limit=0/-1 and dimension mismatch
items.setup: Create REST collection test (dimension=4). Search with limit 0/-1 and vector dim 64/128/2 on a dim=4 collection.

probe_cases.desc: search limit=0 returns HTTP 200 with body error instead of HTTP 400
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status + JSON code. Defect claim: invalid limit placed only in body (code 65535) with HTTP 200; expected 400.

probe_cases.desc: dimension mismatch (64-dim on dim=4) returns HTTP 200 instead of 400
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status + code; defect if body error but HTTP 200.

items.expectation: Invalid limit and dimension mismatch should yield HTTP 4xx (400), not HTTP 200 with error only in the body.
items.contract_hint: Issue: REST returns HTTP 200 for all invalid search params; errors only in JSON body.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2: password complexity not enforced — "abcdefgh" accepted on users/create
items.setup: Call REST users/create with distinct usernames and passwords: '' / 'a' / 'abcdefgh' / 'ValidP@ss1'.

probe_cases.desc: all-lowercase password 'abcdefgh' accepted (complexity not enforced)
probe_cases.observe: HTTP + JSON code. Defect if HTTP 200 + code 200 (user created) for a password with no char-type variety; docs require 3 of 4 types.

probe_cases.desc: complex password control 'ValidP@ss1' accepted
probe_cases.observe: Expect HTTP 200 + code 200 — valid control.

probe_cases.desc: short password 'a' returns body error via HTTP 200
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status vs code; report length validation and its HTTP status.

items.expectation: Password must include at least 3 of 4 char types (uppercase/lowercase/numbers/special) and be 8-64 chars; simple all-lowercase passwords should be rejected.
items.contract_hint: REST Create User doc: password must include at least three character types.

items.title: [Bug]: Upsert fails on autoID=true collections despite documentation claiming support
items.setup: Create REST collection test_upsert_autoid with autoID=True primaryFieldName='uid'. Upsert WITHOUT a primary key.

probe_cases.desc: upsert without PK on autoID=true collection returns code=1100 instead of auto-generating id
probe_cases.observe: JSON code/message. Defect claim: upsert without PK fails (code 1100) though docs say autoID generates PK; contrast control insert on same collection succeeds.

probe_cases.desc: control: insert without PK on autoID=true succeeds (proves autoID mechanism works)
probe_cases.observe: Expect code 200 (auto-generated id) — control proving only upsert breaks.

items.expectation: With autoID=true and no PK provided, upsert should auto-generate the primary key like insert; failing suggests doc/impl mismatch.
items.contract_hint: Upsert Entities doc override mode claims autoID support; Limits section contradicts; impl rejects both with and without PK.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API silently substitutes invalid `consistencyLevel` enum value with default instead of rejecting
items.setup: Create REST collection audit1 with consistencyLevel='Invalid' (dimension=4, metricType=L2, idType=Int64, autoID=true, vectorFieldType=FloatVector). Then describe.

probe_cases.desc: invalid consistencyLevel 'Invalid' silently substituted to 'Bounded' on create
probe_cases.observe: create HTTP+code (code 0 = success). Then collections/describe -> check data.consistencyLevel: if 'Bounded' while `Invalid` submitted => silent substitution (defect); expected rejection.

items.expectation: Invalid enum values must be rejected, not silently default-substituted (Bounded); silent substitution masks client typos.
items.contract_hint: Issue: REST default-substitutes unparseable consistencyLevel to Bounded instead of rejecting.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API silently substitutes invalid `vectorFieldType` enum value with default instead of rejecting
items.setup: Create REST collection audit5 with vectorFieldType='InvalidVectorType' (dimension=4, metricType=L2, idType=Int64, autoID=true). Then describe.

probe_cases.desc: invalid vectorFieldType 'InvalidVectorType' silently substituted to FloatVector
probe_cases.observe: create HTTP+code. Then collections/describe -> check vector field type is FloatVector (silent substitution) vs expected rejection.

items.expectation: Invalid vectorFieldType enum must be rejected, not default-substituted to FloatVector (silent, misleading for binary/sparse users).
items.contract_hint: Issue: REST default-substitutes unparseable vectorFieldType to FloatVector instead of rejecting.

probe_cases.observe: Skip probe; behavior asserted by nprobe-0 probes (#47729/#49823/#49930).

items.title: [Bug]: entities/upsert JSON field — plain string overwrites valid JSON; written value unreadable via gRPC; REST/gRPC store inconsistent formats
items.setup: Create REST collection test_json with schema (autoId False, enableDynamicField False): id Int64 pk, vector FloatVector dim=4, meta JSON. indexParams vector AUTOINDEX COSINE. Insert valid JSON record id=0 with meta={'important':'data'}. Then REST upsert id=0 with meta='invalid_json'; gRPC upsert id=1 with meta='grpc_plain_str'; then query; then gRPC get ids=[0,1].

probe_cases.desc: REST upsert plain string into JSON field overwrites valid JSON and round-trip fails via gRPC
probe_cases.observe: upsert HTTP+code (defect if 0/200 = accepted). Then entities/query output meta -> confirm original {'important':'data'} replaced by bare 'invalid_json'; then pymilvus mc.get ids=[0,1] output_fields=['meta'] -> MilvusException 'Expected object or value' (round-trip failure).

probe_cases.desc: gRPC upsert plain string accepted and stored JSON-encoded (format divergence)
probe_cases.observe: mc.upsert('test_json',[{'id':1,'vector':[0.8]*4,'meta':'grpc_plain_str'}]) accepted; query shows id=1 meta '"grpc_plain_str"' (quoted) vs id=0 bare string — same input, different stored bytes.

items.expectation: A JSON-field value must be readable back via the official gRPC client (round-trip integrity); REST and gRPC must store the same logical value identically; upsert must not silently scalarize structured JSON.
items.contract_hint: JSON Field docs describe type as structured key-value data; server must not accept a write it cannot serve back.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 `entities/insert` accepts string numbers for Int64 primary key (type coercion gap; gRPC rejects)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_pk with schema autoId False: id Int64 pk, vector FloatVector dim=4. indexParams vector AUTOINDEX COSINE. Insert with id='123' (string), then id='abc'. gRPC control: pymilvus insert id='123'.

probe_cases.desc: REST insert with string PK '123' accepted and stored as integer 123
probe_cases.observe: insert code (defect if 0). Then query filter id==123 output id -> stored as integer 123, not string. gRPC control mc.insert id='123' -> should raise DataTypeVariableSetException (imports rejection behavior).

probe_cases.desc: REST insert with non-numeric string PK 'abc' also accepted (stored as 0)
probe_cases.observe: insert code; if accepted, query to see what integer the string was coerced to (claim 'abc' -> 0).

items.expectation: Int64 PK fields must enforce strict type checking; string '123' should be rejected, consistent with gRPC.
items.contract_hint: Primary Field docs define Int64/VarChar PK; REST silently coerces strings instead of rejecting.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 `entities/search` accepts `group_size=0` and `-1` (gRPC rejects as "negative")
items.setup: Create REST collection test_gs dimension=4. Insert 10 rows (id 0..9, vector, cat=i%3). Search with groupParams groupByField='cat' groupSize=0 and -1. gRPC control with group_size=0.

probe_cases.desc: search with groupSize=0 accepted (should be rejected, positive required)
probe_cases.observe: search HTTP+code (defect if code 0 with results). gRPC control: mc.search group_size=0 -> expect code=1100 'group size:0 is negative'. Report both.

probe_cases.desc: search with groupSize=-1 accepted
probe_cases.observe: Defect if code 0 with results; group_size must be positive.

items.expectation: group_size increases results per group and must be a positive integer (>=1); REST should reject 0/negative as gRPC does.
items.contract_hint: Grouping Search docs: group_size controls 'number of results to return per group'.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 `entities/insert` silently coerces scalar types (string→Int64, int→VarChar, string→Bool); gRPC rejects all
items.setup: Create collection test_coerce via pymilvus schema (id INT64 pk, vector FLOAT_VECTOR dim=4, int64_f INT64 nullable, varchar_f VARCHAR(64) nullable, bool_f BOOL nullable). REST insert cross-type values; gRPC controls.

probe_cases.desc: REST insert string '123' into INT64 field accepted (stored as 123)
probe_cases.observe: insert code (defect if 0). Query back int64_f type/value. gRPC control raises 'field type mismatch'.

probe_cases.desc: REST insert int 123 into VarChar field accepted (stored as string)
probe_cases.observe: insert code; query value becomes '123' string.

probe_cases.desc: REST insert string 'true' into BOOL field accepted (stored as true)
probe_cases.observe: insert code; query bool value true.

items.expectation: Scalar fields (Int64/VarChar/Bool/Float) must enforce strict type checking on both REST and gRPC; cross-type coercion is not documented.
items.contract_hint: Number Field docs define distinct INT64/BOOL/FLOAT types; REST still coerces (gRPC fixed in 2.6.14).

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 silently accepts `group_by_field` on vector fields (gRPC rejects "unsupported data type")
items.setup: Create REST collection test_gv dimension=4. Insert 10 rows (id 0..9, vector). Search with groupParams groupByField='vector' (the vector field). gRPC control.

probe_cases.desc: search groupByField='vector' accepted and grouping silently ignored
probe_cases.observe: search HTTP+code (defect if code 0, returns normal ungrouped results). gRPC control: mc.search group_by_field='vector' -> expect code=2001 'unsupported data type VECTOR_FLOAT for group by'. Compare.

items.expectation: Grouping is only valid on scalar fields; groupByField on a vector field must be rejected (not silently ignored).
items.contract_hint: Grouping Search docs describe grouping by scalar fields; vectors cannot be equality-grouped.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 `entities/upsert` accepts string numbers for Int64 primary key (gRPC rejects)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_upsert_pk dimension=4. Insert id=100 (integer). REST upsert id='100' (string) to overwrite. gRPC control.

probe_cases.desc: REST upsert with string PK '100' accepted and overwrites existing record
probe_cases.observe: upsert code (defect if 0). gRPC control mc.upsert id='100' -> expect DataNotMatchException 'id field should be a int64'. Higher risk than insert because it overwrites existing data.

items.expectation: Int64 PK fields must enforce strict type on upsert, consistent with gRPC; a string PK should be rejected, not used to overwrite.
items.contract_hint: Primary Field docs define Int64 as numeric; same coercion gap as insert (higher risk on upsert).

items.title: [Bug]: entities/insert JSON field — plain strings stored in inconsistent formats across REST/gRPC; written values unreadable via gRPC (round-trip failure)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_json (autoId False, enableDynamicField False): id Int64 pk, vector FloatVector dim=4, meta JSON. indexParams AUTOINDEX COSINE. Insert id=100 via REST meta='plain_string'; id=101 via gRPC meta='plain_string'. Then query and gRPC get both ids.

probe_cases.desc: REST-inserted plain-string JSON value becomes unreadable via gRPC; format diverges from gRPC-written row
probe_cases.observe: insert code (defect if 0). Then query -> meta id=100 bare 'plain_string' vs id=101 (gRPC-written) '"plain_string"'. Then mc.get ids=[100,101]: gRPC-written reads back OK, REST-written raises 'Expected object or value'.

probe_cases.desc: gRPC insert same plain string accepted and stored JSON-encoded (format divergence)
probe_cases.observe: mc.insert('test_json',[{'id':101,'vector':[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4],'meta':'plain_string'}]) accepted; stored quoted. Asymmetric round-trip is the decisive evidence.

items.expectation: A record inserted through any official API must be readable via the gRPC client (round-trip integrity); REST and gRPC must store the same value in the same format.
items.contract_hint: Issue: REST/gRPC persist different bytes for the same JSON-string input; REST-written rows unreadable via gRPC.

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 `entities/upsert` silently coerces scalar types (string→DOUBLE, string→BOOL, int→BOOL, string→INT16)
items.setup: Create collection test_upsert_scalar via pymilvus schema (id INT64 pk, vector FLOAT_VECTOR dim=4, dbl_f DOUBLE nullable, bool_f BOOL nullable, i16_f INT16 nullable). REST upsert cross-type values; gRPC controls.

probe_cases.desc: REST upsert string '3.14159' into DOUBLE accepted (stored 3.14159)
probe_cases.observe: upsert code (defect if 0). gRPC control same input -> code=1100 'field type mismatch'.

probe_cases.desc: REST upsert string 'true' into BOOL accepted (stored true)
probe_cases.observe: upsert code; gRPC control rejects.

probe_cases.desc: REST upsert int 1 into BOOL accepted (stored true)
probe_cases.observe: upsert code; gRPC control rejects.

probe_cases.desc: REST upsert string '42' into INT16 accepted (stored 42)
probe_cases.observe: upsert code; gRPC control rejects.

items.expectation: Scalar field types on the UPSERT endpoint must enforce strict type checking, consistent with gRPC; coercion is undocumented.
items.contract_hint: Number Field docs define DOUBLE/BOOL/INT16 as distinct; same root cause as #47766 (gRPC fixed, REST not).

items.title: [Bug]: REST API v2 `entities/insert` accepts string-encoded vector values (gRPC rejects)
items.setup: Create REST collection test_vec_str dimension=4. Insert with vector as string '[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]' (not an array). gRPC control.

probe_cases.desc: REST insert with string-encoded vector accepted and stored as real float vector
probe_cases.observe: insert code (defect if 0, insertCount 1). Then search with [[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]] -> id 0 returns distance 1.0 confirming it was parsed. gRPC control mc.insert vector '[0.1,..]' -> DataNotMatchException 'should be float_vector, got str'.

items.expectation: Vector fields must accept JSON arrays of numbers only, not string-encoded arrays; REST should be consistent with gRPC.
items.contract_hint: Dense Vector docs: vectors are 'arrays of floating-point numbers', not serialized strings.

items.title: [Bug]: REST v2 entities/search silently ignores strictGroupSize
items.setup: Create collection gs_demo via pymilvus (id INT64 pk auto_id=False, vector FLOAT_VECTOR dim=4, cat INT64). Insert 15 points (5 cat values x 3 each), create AUTOINDEX COSINE, load. Search groupByField=cat groupSize=2 strictGroupSize=true limit=15 via REST; gRPC control.

probe_cases.desc: REST search with strictGroupSize=true returns 15 (should cap at 5 groups x 2 = 10)
probe_cases.observe: REST result count vs gRPC control (mc.search group_size=2, strict_group_size=True -> 10). Defect if REST returns 15 (strictGroupSize ignored).

items.expectation: strictGroupSize=true must cap each group at groupSize entities; REST silently ignoring it returns more rows than requested.
items.contract_hint: REST v2 Search docs: 'strictGroupSize: Whether to return only the top k entities for each group'.
